messages:
maria: Heads-up — we rolled the v3 structured log schema to 3 regions yesterday. Seeing a ~3x spike in ingested envelope size from GPU nodes in eu-west starting ~02:30 UTC. Might be correlated with per-step KV dumps from the new runtime patch. Investigating.
sam: Ack. Do we have a quick query to verify which fields grew? `sum by(field) (rate(log_bytes_total[5m]))` pointed at the ingest cluster?
devon: Added a Grafana panel showing `gpu_node_log_ingest_rate` and `log_bytes_total` by field. Early sign is `kv_snapshot` and `layer_states` fields. Those are large when sequence length > 4k.
zoe: That matches the runtime change in v1.9 where we added debug-level KV snapshots for cold-starts. We intended those to be sampled but the sampling flag wasn't honored for those new fields.
maria: Right — sampling rule missed `kv_snapshot`. We need two things: (1) emergency circuit-breaker rule to drop or compact large fields when ingest rate > 5 GB/min per region, (2) a privacy check to ensure embeddings/base64 blobs are never persisted.
sam: Proposed emergency sampler (JSON config snippet):
```json
{
  "rule": "gpu_oversize_compact",
  "when": "ingest_rate > 5GB/min",
  "action": {
    "compact_fields": ["kv_snapshot", "layer_states"],
    "replacement": "<COMPACTED: size={{orig_size}}>",
    "downsample": 0.1
  }
}
```
devon: We should add an alert: `Alert:GPULogIngestBurst` fires if `sum(rate(log_bytes_total[1m])) by(region) > 5e9` for 2m. Attach runbook to flip circuit-breaker. Also make sure alert targets #oncall and has an auto-mitigation step.
zoe: For PII redaction, let's add a relaxed heuristic that runs pre-ingest: remove any field matching base64 regex > 256 chars or any field with patterns like `/embedding|token_vector|kv_blob/i`. Example regex check: `^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{256,}={0,2}$` to catch long base64.
maria: That regex is a good start but we need to avoid false positives for valid short ids. Add length threshold and require it to be present alongside an explicit key match (e.g., key name contains "embed" or "kv").
sam: Also propose we add a lightweight fingerprint for redacted blobs so we can still correlate without storing content: store `sha256_hex` and size. Keep sha256 limited to first 12 chars to reduce correlation risk.
zoe: Can we implement circuit-breaker as a config in the ingest proxy so rollback is fast? If it's proxied we can toggle without redeploying runtime.
devon: Yes — proxy feature flag sounds best. I'll add a `ingest.circuit_breaker.enabled` flag and a `compact_profile` per-region.
maria: On dashboards/SLOs: add an "Ingest cost per GPU-hour" panel + alert if 1h rolling cost spikes >20% vs baseline. Also add a panel for "compact rate" (percentage of ingests compacted) so we can monitor mitigations' impact.
sam: I'll own the dashboard changes and wire the compact_rate metric. Also will add canary gate: if compacting >25% for >10m in prod region, auto-open a ticket and pause the circuit-breaker until an oncall acknowledges.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout of v3-log-schema -> eu-west completed at 2035012400. No errors during primary deploy stage.
maria: After we flip the emergency rule in eu-west for a 10m canary, we'll monitor ingest bytes and application tail latency. If tail P99 increases by >50ms we'll revert.
zoe: Action items: @sam update sampling rules + dashboard, @devon add alert and runbook, @maria add regex whitelist/blacklist for PII, @deploy-bot coordinate canary toggle. I'll send a follow-up with snippets for the proxy feature flag.
maria: Will also open a quick postmortem note once we confirm root cause. For now putting a temporary tag `posture:ingest-high` on affected hosts so we can query them easily.
sam: Thanks — ping me when the proxy flag is ready. I'll stage the sampler in staging then roll to canary.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
